scenes.say: Ever wondered why your test environment needs to look just like production? Let’s break down why it matters.

scenes.label: Hardware
scenes.sub: Use the same machine specs as production for valid results.
scenes.say: First, match hardware specs. If your test server is weaker than production, your results won’t reflect real-world performance.
Here’s what I always check: virtual machine size, database version, and network. Make sure nothing else is running during tests.

scenes.question: Why isolate your test environment?
scenes.wrong: To save resources for other apps.
scenes.right: Isolation prevents interference, so your results stay reliable.
scenes.say: Interviewers love to ask about isolation. It’s not just about saving resources—it’s about avoiding interference so your results are trustworthy.
